claude-opus-4.8.name: Claude 4.8 Opus
claude-opus-4.8.tokenizer_drift_warning: Claude Opus 4.8 inherits the Opus 4.7 tokenizer baseline (re-baselined 2026-04): the same input text can yield 1.0x to 1.35x tokens vs prior Claude families (Sonnet 4.6, Opus <=4.6). Re-baseline cost + latency budgets; cached prompts from earlier models may overshoot the context window. See packages/routing/src/three-tier-router.ts ESTIMATE_INFLATION.

deepseek-v4-pro.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro
deepseek-v4-pro.pricingNote: DeepSeek made its 75% V4-Pro launch discount permanent on 2026-05-22: flat $0.435/$0.87 per 1M tokens, cache-read $0.003625. No post-promo reversion.

kimi-k2.6.name: Kimi K2.6
kimi-k2.6.supersedes_note: All kimi-k2-* and kimi-k2.5* aliases are EOL 2026-05-25 per Moonshot deprecation notice. Use kimi-k2.6 only; canonicalization map redirects legacy IDs for transitional compatibility.

imagen-4-fast.name: Imagen 4 Fast
imagen-4-fast.pricingNote: Fast variant of Imagen 4 — $0.02/image at 1024x1024 (vs $0.04 for Imagen 4 standard, $0.06 for Ultra). Per auto-routing-spec.md §4 Pool B image slot.

runway-gen-4.name: Runway Gen-4
runway-gen-4.pricingNote: Runway Gen-4 remains an alternate third-party video provider entry. Default AGI video routing uses the verified current Google Veo route unless product policy explicitly chooses Runway.

gpt-image-2.name: GPT Image 2
gpt-image-2.pricingNote: OpenAI image generation guide uses a calculator for gpt-image-2 output-token/cost estimation; common 1024x1024 estimates are $0.006 low, $0.053 medium, and $0.211 high.
